name: ThingsBoard
tagline: Open-source IoT platform REST API for devices, telemetry, rules, and dashboards
description: ThingsBoard Community Edition is an open-source IoT platform; Cloud and Professional editions are also offered. Its REST API manages platform entities, integrations, device provisioning, telemetry, attributes, alarms, rule chains, dashboards, and custom applications. API-key authentication via X-Authorization: ApiKey is recommended; username/password JWT login remains supported but is deprecated. Device transport APIs use separate device credentials.

auth.details: POST /api/auth/login with username/password returns JWT; send as X-Authorization: Bearer $JWT (or Authorization). Device APIs may use access tokens. Self-host and cloud.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community Edition: free, open-source self-hosting with unlimited devices/assets. Cloud Free ($0/month): 5 devices, 5 assets, 2 customers, 5 users, 5 dashboards, 3 rule chains; 0.5M transport messages and 1M data points/month; 30-day TTL.
pricing.paid_plans: ThingsBoard Cloud and PE paid tiers; self-host PE licenses

rate_limits: Cloud REST limits: Free—tenant 100 requests/s and 1,000/min; customer 50/s and 500/min. Paid plans—tenant 100/s and 2,000/min; customer 50/s and 1,000/min. Transport, device, gateway, and WebSocket limits are also published by plan.
use_cases: login and obtain JWT for ThingsBoard REST API
list tenant devices and their credentials
post or query device telemetry timeseries
manage dashboards and rule chains via REST
